hook: Your boat glides through caves of swirling blue stone.
title: A Boat Ride Through Swirling Blue Marble
description:
The Marble Caves sit on General Carrera Lake in Patagonia, Chile. The lake's waves carved the marble into smooth chambers with swirling blue and white patterns. You reach them by boat.

#Shorts #MarbleCaves #Patagonia
comment_prompt: Would you ride this boat? Yes or no
